name: @tochii/osb-toolkit-native
description: wasm-bindgen binding of the osbTK runtime for JavaScript/TypeScript (browser + Node).
author: T0chi

scripts.build:wasm: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('wasm',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsx ../../scripts/cargo.ts build -p osb-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir wasm --out-name osb_wasm ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/osb_wasm.wasm && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('wasm/package.json',JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
